source.dataset: DeltaDTM v1.1, a global coastal digital terrain model (bare earth), 1 arc-second
source.provider: Pronk, M., Hooijer, A., Eilander, D. et al. (2024), Scientific Data 11:273; 4TU.ResearchData, doi:10.4121/21997565 (CC BY 4.0). source.verticalDatum: EGM2008 geoid (approx. mean sea level), metres
source.resampling: The tile was supplied in UTM 43N (30 m, already a resampling of DeltaDTM's 1 arc-second grid) and reprojected back to EPSG:4326 at 1 arc-second (bilinear) so this script can read it: two resamplings before this one. Each 0.0005 deg cell takes the mean of the pixels whose centres fall in it, after dropping pixels above 10 m (outside DeltaDTM's domain); 27141 cells with no DeltaDTM value keep the GLO-30 value; 4 land cells below -1 m are clamped to 0 m.

encoding: base64 little-endian Int16, row-major, same grid as panjimCrzGrid.json
grounding_note: DeltaDTM corrects GLO-30 to bare earth with ICESat-2 and GEDI lidar (reported vertical mean absolute error 0.45 m), so buildings and canopy no longer raise the heights. Still a 30 m global model resampled to ~55 m cells, not a survey: sub-metre detail (drains, walls, road crowns) is not resolved.
